items.intent: Tuck the spoon under the loose tile beside the cot.
Hide the spoon in the folds of the blanket.
Slip the spoon into the hollow under the tile and press the tile flat over it.
Lift the loose tile to uncover the hollow beneath it.
Kneel beside the loose tile, lift it out of its seat, and closely examine the hollow beneath for hidden tools or freshly disturbed grit.
Scoop a handful of grit out of the hollow under the tile and keep it.
Scrape at the cracked mortar around the base of the bar with the spoon.
Pick up the spoon and closely examine its edge for signs of sharpening.
take a wire out of the cot
